nodes.description: Public uint256 token id (51) of the ERC1155 being auctioned.
Address of the ERC1155 token contract used in transfers.
Boolean flag marking the auction as finished; guards end() and pull().
Unix timestamp when the auction starts.
Payable address receiving the protocol fee.
Payable address of the seller receiving proceeds or the NFT on pull.
Duration (20.5 hours) an existing bid must stand before it can be outbid or ended.
Total auction duration (20.5 hours) from startBidTime.
Amount of the current winning bid in wei.
Timestamp of the last accepted bid; 0 means no bids yet.
Payable address of the current highest bidder.
Initializes token, id, start time, minimum bid, seller and haus.
Payable bidding entrypoint; enforces tx.origin == msg.sender and time windows, refunds the previous bidder.
Finalizes the auction: transfers ERC1155 to winner, pays haus fee and seller, sets ended.
Returns the ERC1155 to the seller if the auction expired with no bids.
View helper that reports whether the auction is still running.
ERC1155 receiver hook returning the acceptance selector.
Caller-controlled address used as bidder, winner and checked against tx.origin.
Miner-influenced timestamp driving all auction time checks.
Transaction origin compared with msg.sender to block contract bidders.
External ETH refund to the previous winning bidder inside bid().
External ETH fee transfer to haus inside end().
External ETH transfer of the remaining balance to the seller inside end().
External ERC1155 call transferring the NFT to the winner inside end().
External ERC1155 call transferring the NFT back to the seller inside pull().
Local cache of address(this).balance in end().
Local computed fee (balance/20*3) paid to haus in end().

edges.reason: constructor assigns id = 51
constructor assigns the ERC1155 token address
constructor assigns startBidTime
constructor assigns the initial lastBid (0.5 ether)
constructor assigns the haus fee receiver
constructor assigns the seller
bid() uses msg.sender in the require(msg.sender == tx.origin) gate
tx.origin gates bid() execution via require(msg.sender == tx.origin)
bid() stores msg.sender into winning
block.timestamp controls the startBidTime/auctionLength checks in bid()
bid() writes block.timestamp into lastBidTime
end() time window is decided purely by block.timestamp comparisons
pull() requires block.timestamp >= startBidTime + auctionLength
live() returns a result based only on block.timestamp
bid() computes the minimum bid as lastBid.mul(105).div(100) on untrusted/state values
bidLength is used in lastBidTime.add(bidLength) arithmetic inside bid()
auctionLength is used in startBidTime.add(auctionLength) arithmetic inside bid()
end() computes lastBidTime.add(bidLength) to decide whether the auction ended
end() computes startBidTime.add(auctionLength) to decide whether the auction ended
pull() computes startBidTime.add(auctionLength)
live() computes lastBidTime.add(bidLength)
live() computes startBidTime.add(auctionLength)
bid() reads lastBidTime to decide whether a previous bidder must be refunded
end() reverts when lastBidTime == 0 because there were no bids
pull() requires lastBidTime == 0 before returning the NFT to the seller
end() is guarded by require(!ended) and writes ended = true
pull() is guarded by require(!ended) and sets ended = true
the previous winner address receives lastBid via transfer(), an external call to a potentially contract-controlled address
lastBid is the value sent in the external refund transfer() inside bid()
external ETH transfer to winning occurs before lastBid/winning/lastBidTime are updated, allowing re-entry into bid()
end() calls IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom for the winner
token id is passed to safeTransferFrom in end()
winning address is the recipient of the ERC1155 transfer in end()
ERC1155 token contract is called before ended = true and before the ETH payouts, so a malicious token can re-enter end()
ERC1155 transfer to a contract triggers onERC1155Received on the receiving side of the hook
pull() calls IERC1155(token).safeTransferFrom for the seller
token id is passed to safeTransferFrom in pull()
seller is the recipient of the ERC1155 transfer in pull()
external ERC1155 call happens before ended = true in pull(), allowing re-entry
haus is the recipient of the external fee transfer() in end()
hausFee = balance.div(20).mul(3) is the amount forwarded to haus
seller receives the whole remaining balance through an external transfer() in end()
the balance read is used to compute the payout amounts in end()

onERC1155Received binds its second unnamed parameter
onERC1155Received binds its third unnamed parameter
onERC1155Received binds its fourth unnamed parameter
onERC1155Received binds its fifth unnamed parameter

normalization_plan.reason: The local balance is only a cache of address(this).balance used to size the external seller transfer, so it should be folded into that unsafe_operation.
The local hausFee only parameterizes the haus transfer call and carries no independent semantics beyond that unsafe_operation.
